name: cleaning
description: Cleaning a home, once or on a schedule.

appointmentWindowHours.description: How wide the arrival window is, in hours: the seller arrives within this many hours of the booked time.

howDealsGo: Each clean is its own escrow, paid at booking. Done is the home clean when the cleaner leaves, and the buyer releases after a look round. A timer to the seller, set past the visit, pays for work done if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, agree what is included: windows, oven, supplies.
